$comment: How ShinyQ HQ itself was built (owner request 2026-10-15). Knowledge for the Ask the HQ chatbot only: this file is not rendered; the long form is the /build page (content/build-story.json). It becomes one knowledge chunk (`site-build`) that is always retrieved for questions about this site (`isSiteQuestion` in functions/_lib/scope.ts), and an answer to such a question cites the /build page (`SITE_BUILD_PAGE` in src/ask/pack.ts), which links `source`, the public repository. Facts only, third person, verified against the repository; never a client company (C3), a cloud resource name, a hostname or a number that is not in the repository. It covers the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates, the visitor controls, per-page URLs and ?view=classic, the Study Vault, the secret B1 Engine Room and the Agent Office (what it shows and its privacy rule, never its live data). Update it in the same PR when the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates or the visitor controls (Rover, floors, minimap, settings, links) change. Validated by SiteBuildSchema (src/content/schema.ts) and the forbidden-pattern lint (scripts/validate-fragment.ts).

text.en: Work on ShinyQ HQ began in October 2026. AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) implemented Kurniadi's written specs; he reviewed and merged their pull requests. The stack is Next.js 16 static export, React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl (English, Indonesian) and zod-validated content, built with pinned Bun 1.4 and Node 24. React Three Fiber, three.js and zustand power the 3D tower in full, lite or static tiers. The Classic site presents the same content as accessible HTML without WebGL. Cloudflare Pages and Functions host it with KV, R2, Analytics Engine and two Workers: hq-stats refreshes visit stats hourly; hq-office runs the Agent Office. Ask AI opens Ask Rover Assistant, a separate chat panel (internally Ask the HQ). Rover speaks as the guide, refers to Kurniadi in the third person and answers only from public site content curated into a KV knowledge pack, with five turns of memory. Gemma 4 on Workers AI via AI Gateway answers first, then Mistral Small 3.1 and Groq provide fallbacks. Turnstile, rate limits and output checks guard each request. Vitest, Playwright, Lighthouse CI and 3D budgets check draw calls, triangles, JavaScript size and memory. Pull requests run affected checks; nightly runs cover everything plus assistant evals. Merges deploy by workflow; red main CI triggers rollback. Source: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ on GitHub. Rover is a small robot guide. Drive it with WASD, arrows or a touch joystick. Shift or a joystick double-tap doubles its speed. Point-and-go drives to glowing rooms, pads or boards and opens them: click, or double-tap on touch. The elevator serves L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing and the RF roof deck. A first-visit tutorial and hints explain the controls. The Rover menu offers room shortcuts; the minimap or N opens a floor overview and destination picker. Settings cover language, motion, graphics, day/night, minimap, sound and music. Pages have shareable URLs, including project and floor links in 3D. ?view=classic selects the Classic site; ordinary links follow the recipient's remembered view. The L4 Study Vault and Classic Writing page open certification study guides in the same PDF reader. Visit all five public floors to unlock B1 Engine Room. Its seven stations mirror /build: architecture, rounds, agents, gates, figures, Ask and rejected designs. In a Lobby wing, the Agent Office shows live hook updates as Rovers at up to ten desks (two rows of five). Titles appear only for allowlisted public repositories; others show "Client project". Code, prompts, file paths and client names stay on his machine. A screen wall adds public GitHub activity; with quiet hooks the office is semi-live. The Classic home has a Live Agent Office card.
text.id: Kurniadi membangun ShinyQ HQ sejak Oktober 2026: AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) mengerjakan spec tertulisnya lewat pull request yang ia review dan merge. Stack: static export Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl (Inggris, Indonesia), konten divalidasi zod; build memakai Bun 1.4 dan Node 24 (dipin). Menara 3D: three.js lewat React Three Fiber dan zustand, tier full, lite atau static; Situs klasik: konten sama dalam HTML aksesibel tanpa WebGL. Hosting: Cloudflare Pages dan Functions, KV, R2, Analytics Engine dan dua Worker (hq-stats memperbarui statistik kunjungan tiap jam, hq-office untuk Agent Office). Tanya AI membuka panel chat terpisah, Asisten Rover (internal: Ask the HQ): Rover menjawab dengan suaranya sendiri tentang Kurniadi (orang ketiga), hanya dari pack konten publik terkurasi di KV, dan mengingat lima giliran. Model: Gemma 4 di Workers AI lewat AI Gateway, lalu Mistral Small 3.1, lalu Groq, dengan Turnstile, rate limit dan output check. Pengujian: Vitest, Playwright, Lighthouse CI dan budget 3D (draw call, segitiga, ukuran JS, memori); PR memeriksa bagian terdampak, run malam semuanya plus evaluasi asisten. Merge memicu deploy lewat workflow; CI main gagal memicu rollback. Sumber: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ di GitHub. Rover adalah robot pemandu kecil: kemudikan dengan WASD, panah atau joystick sentuh; Shift (atau ketuk dua kali joystick) mempercepatnya jadi 2x. Point-and-go (klik, atau ketuk dua kali di layar sentuh) menuju dan membuka ruangan, pad atau papan bercahaya. Lift melayani L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing dan dek atap RF. Tutorial awal dan petunjuk menjelaskan kontrol. Menu Rover berisi pintasan ruangan; minimap (atau N) membuka peta lantai dan pilihan tujuan. Pengaturan: bahasa, motion, grafis, siang/malam, minimap, suara dan musik. Tiap halaman punya URL untuk dibagikan; di 3D, tautan proyek atau lantai menuju lokasinya. ?view=classic memilih Situs klasik; tautan biasa mengikuti tampilan yang diingat penerima. Study Vault di L4 membuka panduan belajar sertifikasinya di pembaca PDF situs (juga di Writing Situs klasik). Kunjungi kelima lantai publik untuk membuka Ruang Mesin B1 di lift. Tujuh stasiunnya mengikuti halaman /build (arsitektur, putaran, agent, gate, angka, Ask, desain yang ditolak). Agent Office di sayap Lobi menampilkan AI coding agent Kurniadi lewat hook secara live: Rover di maksimal sepuluh meja (dua baris berisi lima) dengan status dan aktivitasnya. Judul hanya tampil untuk repositori publik yang diizinkan, lainnya "Proyek klien"; kode, prompt, path file dan nama klien tak pernah keluar dari mesinnya. Dinding layar menampilkan aktivitas GitHub publik; saat hook sepi, kantor semi-live. Beranda Situs klasik memuat kartu Kantor Agen Live.
